description: This file contains the implementation of stock ledger operations in ERPNext, including stock entry processing, rate calculations, stock reconciliation, and validation for negative stock levels.

classes.name: update_entries_after
classes.description: Class for updating valuation rate and quantity after a stock transaction from a specific time-bucket onwards.

methods.name: make_sl_entries
methods.description: Creates stock ledger entries, handles cancellation, and updates stock bins.

methods.name: repost_current_voucher
methods.description: Reposts stock ledger entries for a specific voucher, updating valuation and stock quantities.

methods.name: validate_serial_no
methods.description: Validates serial numbers against future transactions to prevent inconsistencies.

methods.name: validate_cancellation
methods.description: Validates if a transaction can be canceled based on reposting status.

methods.name: set_as_cancel
methods.description: Marks stock ledger entries as canceled.

methods.name: make_entry
methods.description: Creates and submits a new stock ledger entry document.

methods.name: repost_future_sle
methods.description: Reposts stock ledger entries for future transactions, updating quantities and valuation rates.

methods.name: validate_item_warehouse
methods.description: Ensures required fields are present for reposting items.

methods.name: update_args_in_repost_item_valuation
methods.description: Updates the database with the latest list of items to be reposted.

methods.name: get_items_to_be_repost
methods.description: Retrieves list of stock ledger entries to be reposted for a given voucher.

methods.name: get_distinct_item_warehouse
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of unique item and warehouse combinations for reposting.

methods.name: get_current_index
methods.description: Returns the current index in the reposting process.

methods.name: get_previous_sle_of_current_voucher
methods.description: Fetches the previous stock ledger entry before the current voucher.

methods.name: get_previous_sle
methods.description: Fetches the last stock ledger entry before or on a given date/time.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Retrieves stock ledger entries filtered by posting date/time conditions.

methods.name: get_sle_by_voucher_detail_no
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entry by voucher detail number, excluding a specific entry.

methods.name: get_valuation_rate
methods.description: Calculates the valuation rate for an item based on recent stock ledger entries or item data.

methods.name: update_qty_in_future_sle
methods.description: Recalculates future stock ledger entries' quantities after a transaction.

methods.name: get_stock_reco_qty_shift
methods.description: Calculates quantity shift caused by stock reconciliation.

methods.name: get_next_stock_reco
methods.description: Finds the next stock reconciliation entry after a given date/time.

methods.name: get_datetime_limit_condition
methods.description: Generates SQL condition to limit stock ledger entries before a specific date/time.

methods.name: validate_negative_qty_in_future_sle
methods.description: Checks for future stock ledger entries with negative quantities to prevent stock inconsistencies.

methods.name: get_future_sle_with_negative_qty
methods.description: Fetches future stock ledger entries with negative stock levels.

methods.name: get_future_sle_with_negative_batch_qty
methods.description: Fetches future stock ledger entries with negative batch quantities.

methods.name: _round_off_if_near_zero
methods.description: Rounds a number to zero if it is very close to zero within a specified precision.
